title: Generation of DATcrePink1 Knockout Mice Expressing tdTomato in Dopaminergic Neurons
author: Marie-Josée Bourque
materials: Procedure for DNA extraction from mouse tails:
Step 1a: Cross DAT IREScre with Pink1 mice

steps.title: Maintain mouse housing conditions
steps.instruction: Keep all mice on a 12 h light/12 h dark cycle at 21 °C, 60 % relative humidity, with ad libitum standard rodent chow and water, and monitor health status daily.

steps.title: Establish DAT‑cre/Pink1 breeding scheme
steps.instruction: Perform the following matings to generate DATcrePink1 offspring:

substeps.instruction: Mate DAT IREScre/cre mice with Pink1‑/‑ mice; all progeny will be DAT IREScre/+ ; Pink1 +/‑.
Mate DAT IREScre/+ ; Pink1 +/- mice with DAT IREScre/cre mice; 25 % of the progeny will be DAT IREScre/cre ; Pink1 +/-.
Optional: Mate DAT IREScre/cre ; Pink1 +/- mice with each other to raise the proportion of DAT IREScre/cre ; Pink1 +/- mice to ~50 %.

steps.title: Establish Ai9/Pink1 breeding scheme (parallel)
steps.instruction: In parallel, set up the following matings:

substeps.instruction: Mate Ai9 fl/fl mice with Pink1‑/‑ mice; all progeny will be Ai9 fl/+ ; Pink1 +/-.
Mate Ai9 fl/+ ; Pink1 +/- mice with Ai9 fl/fl mice; 25 % of the progeny will be Ai9 fl/fl ; Pink1 +/-.
Optional: Mate Ai9 fl/fl ; Pink1 +/- mice with each other to raise the proportion of Ai9 fl/fl ; Pink1 +/- mice to ~50 %.

steps.title: Cross DAT‑cre/Pink1 with Ai9/Pink1 lines
steps.instruction: Mate DAT IREScre/cre ; Pink1 +/- mice with Ai9 fl/fl ; Pink1 +/- mice. All offspring will be DAT IREScre/+ ; Ai9 fl/+, with 25 % Pink1 KO, 25 % Pink1 WT and 50 % Pink1 heterozygous, yielding the final DATcrePink1 mice that express tdTomato in dopaminergic neurons.

steps.title: Collect tail tip for genotyping
steps.instruction: Excise a ~0.2 cm piece of tail tip from each mouse for DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from tail
steps.instruction: For each tail tip, prepare a lysis mixture and incubate:

substeps.instruction: Pre‑mix 88 µL water, 2 µL KAPAExpress Extract Enzyme, and 10 µL KAPAExpress Extract Buffer; vortex thoroughly.
Place the mixture in a 1.5 mL sterile microcentrifuge tube containing the tail tip, ensuring the tissue is fully immersed.
Incubate 10 min at 75 °C (lysis) then 5 min at 95 °C (enzyme inactivation).

steps.title: Set up PCR genotyping reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR mix for each tail DNA sample as follows:

substeps.instruction: 4.5 µL nuclease‑free water
12.5 µL KAPA2G Fast Genotyping Mix (1 X final)
0.5 µL MgCl₂ (25 mM stock) → final 2 mM
1.25 µL Pink1 WT Forward primer (4 µM) → final 0.2 µM
1.25 µL Pink1 WT Reverse primer (4 µM) → final 0.2 µM
1.25 µL Pink1 KO Forward primer (4 µM) → final 0.2 µM
1.25 µL Pink1 KO Reverse primer (4 µM) → final 0.2 µM
1.5 µL DMSO → final 6 %
1 µL extracted DNA sample

steps.title: Run touchdown PCR program
steps.instruction: Place the PCR tubes in a thermocycler and run the following program (≈2 h total):

substeps.instruction: 1) 95 °C for 5 min
2) 95 °C for 30 s
3) 61 °C for 30 s
4) 72 °C for 45 s
5) Return to step 2 and repeat steps 2‑4 eight additional cycles (touchdown –0.5 °C per cycle).
6) 95 °C for 20 s
7) 54 °C for 20 s
8) 72 °C for 30 s
9) Return to step 6 and repeat steps 6‑8 twenty‑five times.
10) 72 °C for 5 min
11) Hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a gel suitable for resolving 310‑bp and 450‑bp PCR products:

substeps.instruction: Combine 100 mL 0.5 X TBE buffer with 1.5 g agarose powder in a 500 mL glass Erlenmeyer flask.
Microwave ~2 min, swirling every minute, until the agarose is fully dissolved and no particles are visible.
Add 7 µL BET (final concentration 0.7 µg/mL).
Allow the gel to polymerize for 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Load samples and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load each PCR reaction onto the prepared gel and run at the maximum voltage for this gel (150 V) until the dye front has migrated an appropriate distance.

steps.title: Image gel and interpret genotypes
steps.instruction: Capture an image of the gel using a gel imager and compare band sizes to controls:

substeps.instruction: Knock‑out allele: 450 bp band.
Wild‑type allele: 310 bp band.
Heterozygous: both 310 bp and 450 bp bands.
Lane layout: 1 = Molecular weight ladder (Fermentas cat.# SM1153), 2‑16 = samples, 17 = KO control, 18 = heterozygous control, 19 = WT control, 20 = H₂O (negative) control.
